responsibility: Implements GCC’s dominator and postdominator computation and maintenance machinery. It computes immediate dominators using the Lengauer-Tarjan algorithm, builds and updates dominance trees and fast-query structures backed by Euler-tour forests, supports region-based and incremental dominator recomputation after CFG edits, tracks availability state for dominance info, and exposes traversal of dominance children. It consumes the CFG and produces the dominance relations that many CFG, SSA, and loop analyses depend on.
same_name_distinction: Implements the dominator/postdominator algorithms and maintenance routines declared in gcc/dominance.h, including Lengauer-Tarjan computation, incremental updates, and the Euler-tour-forest-backed dominance tree/query machinery.
